content.title: Game Notes: Portland Trail Blazers vs Denver Nuggets, 7:00 p.m. | Portland Trail Blazers
content.text: Denver Nuggets (14-10, 7-6 away) @ Portland Trail Blazers (8-18, 5-7 home)Thursday, December 19, 2024 • 7:00 pm PDT • Moda CenterSERIES HISTORYALL TIME: Trail Blazers lead, 113-109PORTLAND HOME: Trail Blazers lead, 78-33DENVER HOME: Nuggets lead, 35-76LAST PORTLAND WIN: 135-110, 10/24/22 (POR)LAST DENVER WIN: 111-114, 3/23/24 (POR)CURRENT WIN STREAK: Seven (DEN)SERIES NOTESBlazers second year forward Toumani Camara continues to be a bright spot for the Blazers this season. He has recorded a steal in 23 games this season, tied for the league lead (TJ McConnell). Toumani is currently averaging 1.4 steals per game.Sunday’s game against Phoenix marked the fifth time this season all five Blazer starters finished in double-figures, a feat the Blazers accomplished just three times all of last season.On back-to-back nights against the Wizards and Hawks (12/7 and 12/8), Nikola Jokic recorded 104 points, 30 rebounds, 16 assists and 4 steals. It was just the fourth time in NBA history that a player has scored 104+ points in a 24-hour span since the merger in 1976. It was just the 26th time in league history a player had scored 104+ in back-to-back games.Nikola Jokic recorded his league-leading 10th triple-double on Monday. On December 1st Jokic tied Magic Johnson for the third-most triple-doubles all-time, and then passed him on December 5th.
